name: favorites-app
description: Personal favorites library (Capacitor: iOS + Android / Android TV)

scripts.test: node tests/run.mjs && node tests/native.mjs && node tests/tv.mjs && node tests/studio.mjs
scripts.android:prepare: npm run build && (npx cap add android || true) && node scripts/patch-android.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.ios:prepare: npm run build && (npx cap add ios || true) && node scripts/patch-ios.mjs && npx cap sync ios
